- Running the executable with any inputs, flags, and arguments to observe its behavior

content.text: I’m going to implement a clean-room Python reimplementation: a CLI-compatible script that parses common SVD XML/JSON, emits svd2rust-style Rust register APIs, and supports the documented flags. I’ll also add `compile.sh` and `.gitignore` so the generated executable is an ignored build artifact.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Small clean-room svd2rust-compatible generator.

This implementation is based only on observed command-line behaviour and bundled docs.
It supports the common CMSIS-SVD constructs used in tests: devices, CPUs,
peripherals, interrupts, registers, arrays, fields and enumerated values.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import re
import sys
import copy
import html
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any, Optional
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

VERSION = "svd2rust 0.37.1 (e29353d 2026-03-03)"

Usage: executable [OPTIONS]

Options:

      --atomics-feature <FEATURE>

      --ignore-groups

      --keep-list
          Keep lists when generating code of dimElement, instead of trying to generate arrays

  -g, --generic-mod
          Push generic mod in separate file

      --feature-group
          Use group_name of peripherals as feature

      --feature-peripheral
          Use independent cfg feature flags for each peripheral

  -f, --ident-format <ident_format>
          Specify `-f type:prefix:case:suffix` to change default ident formatting.
          Allowed values of `type` are ["cluster_accessor", "field_accessor", "peripheral_singleton", "peripheral_mod", "enum_write_name", "enum_value", "peripheral_feature", "interrupt", "register", "register_spec", "peripheral", "field_reader", "enum_read_name", "register_accessor", "enum_value_accessor", "peripheral_spec", "cluster_mod", "register_mod", "field_writer", "enum_name", "cluster"].
          Allowed cases are `unchanged` (''), `pascal` ('p'), `constant` ('c') and `snake` ('s').
          

      --ident-formats-theme <THEME>
          A set of `ident_format` settings. `new` or `legacy`

      --field-names-for-enums
          Use field name for enumerations even when enumeratedValues has a name

      --max-cluster-size
          Use array increment for cluster size

      --impl-debug
          implement Debug for readable blocks and registers

      --impl-debug-feature <FEATURE>
          Add feature gating for block and register debug implementation

      --impl-defmt <FEATURE>
          Add automatic defmt implementation for enumerated values

  -m, --make-mod

      --skip-crate-attributes

  -s, --strict

      --source-type <source_type>

      --reexport-core-peripherals
          For Cortex-M target reexport peripherals from cortex-m crate

      --reexport-interrupt
          Reexport interrupt macro from cortex-m-rt like crates

  -b, --base-address-shift <base_address_shift>
          Add offset to all base addresses on all peripherals in the SVD file.
          Useful for soft-cores where the peripheral address range isn't necessarily fixed.
          Ignore this option if you are not building your own FPGA based soft-cores.

  -l, --log <log_level>
          Choose which messages to log (overrides RUST_LOG)
          
          [possible values: off, error, warn, info, debug, trace]

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

  -V, --version
          Print version
"""

SHORT_HELP = """Generate a Rust API from SVD files

Usage: executable [OPTIONS]

Options:
  -i <FILE>
          Input SVD file
  -o, --output-dir <PATH>
          Directory to place generated files
  -c, --config <TOML_FILE>
          Config TOML file
      --settings <YAML_FILE>
          Target-specific settings YAML file
      --edition <YEAR>
          Rust edition of generated code
      --target <ARCH>
          Target architecture
      --atomics
          Generate atomic register modification API
      --atomics-feature <FEATURE>
          add feature gating for atomic register modification API
      --ignore-groups
          Don't add alternateGroup name as prefix to register name
      --keep-list
          Keep lists when generating code of dimElement, instead of trying to generate arrays
  -g, --generic-mod
          Push generic mod in separate file
      --feature-group
          Use group_name of peripherals as feature
      --feature-peripheral
          Use independent cfg feature flags for each peripheral
  -f, --ident-format <ident_format>
          Specify `-f type:prefix:case:suffix` to change default ident formatting.
          Allowed values of `type` are ["enum_value_accessor", "register_spec", "cluster", "field_accessor", "peripheral", "enum_write_name", "peripheral_singleton", "peripheral_spec", "enum_value", "cluster_mod", "cluster_accessor", "register_mod", "peripheral_mod", "field_reader", "field_writer", "register", "register_accessor", "enum_read_name", "enum_name", "interrupt", "peripheral_feature"].
          Allowed cases are `unchanged` (''), `pascal` ('p'), `constant` ('c') and `snake` ('s').
          
      --ident-formats-theme <THEME>
          A set of `ident_format` settings. `new` or `legacy`
      --field-names-for-enums
          Use field name for enumerations even when enumeratedValues has a name
      --max-cluster-size
          Use array increment for cluster size
      --impl-debug
          implement Debug for readable blocks and registers
      --impl-debug-feature <FEATURE>
          Add feature gating for block and register debug implementation
      --impl-defmt <FEATURE>
          Add automatic defmt implementation for enumerated values
  -m, --make-mod
          Create mod.rs instead of lib.rs, without inner attributes
      --skip-crate-attributes
          Do not generate crate attributes
  -s, --strict
          Make advanced checks due to parsing SVD
      --source-type <source_type>
          Specify file/stream format
      --reexport-core-peripherals
          For Cortex-M target reexport peripherals from cortex-m crate
      --reexport-interrupt
          Reexport interrupt macro from cortex-m-rt like crates
  -b, --base-address-shift <base_address_shift>
          Add offset to all base addresses on all peripherals in the SVD file.
  -l, --log <log_level>
          Choose which messages to log (overrides RUST_LOG) [possible values: off, error, warn, info, debug, trace]
  -h, --help
          Print help (see more with '--help')
  -V, --version
          Print version
"""

LOG_LEVELS = {"off": 0, "error": 1, "warn": 2, "info": 3, "debug": 4, "trace": 5}

@dataclass
class Config:
    input: Optional[str] = None
    output_dir: Optional[str] = None
    config: Optional[str] = None
    settings: Optional[str] = None
    edition: str = "2021"
    target: str = "cortex-m"
    atomics: bool = False
    atomics_feature: Optional[str] = None
    ignore_groups: bool = False
    keep_list: bool = False
    generic_mod: bool = False
    feature_group: bool = False
    feature_peripheral: bool = False
    field_names_for_enums: bool = False
    max_cluster_size: bool = False
    impl_debug: bool = False
    impl_debug_feature: Optional[str] = None
    impl_defmt: Optional[str] = None
    make_mod: bool = False
    skip_crate_attributes: bool = False
    strict: bool = False
    source_type: Optional[str] = None
    reexport_core_peripherals: bool = False
    reexport_interrupt: bool = False
    base_address_shift: int = 0
    log_level: Optional[str] = None
    ident_formats: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    ident_formats_theme: Optional[str] = None

@dataclass
class EnumValue:
    name: str
    desc: str = ""
    value: Optional[int] = None
    is_default: bool = False

@dataclass
class Field:
    name: str
    desc: str = ""
    bit_offset: int = 0
    bit_width: int = 1
    access: Optional[str] = None
    enums: list[EnumValue] = field(default_factory=list)

@dataclass
class Register:
    name: str
    desc: str = ""
    offset: int = 0
    size: int = 32
    access: str = "read-write"
    reset_value: Optional[int] = None
    fields: list[Field] = field(default_factory=list)
    dim: Optional[int] = None
    dim_increment: int = 0
    dim_indices: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)

@dataclass
class Interrupt:
    name: str
    desc: str = ""
    value: int = 0

@dataclass
class Peripheral:
    name: str
    desc: str = ""
    base: int = 0
    group_name: Optional[str] = None
    registers: list[Register] = field(default_factory=list)
    interrupts: list[Interrupt] = field(default_factory=list)
    derived_from: Optional[str] = None

@dataclass
class Device:
    name: str = ""
    desc: str = ""
    width: int = 32
    nvic_prio_bits: Optional[int] = None
    peripherals: list[Peripheral] = field(default_factory=list)

# ---------------- CLI ----------------

def clap_error(msg: str, usage: Optional[str] = None) -> int:
    sys.stderr.write(f"error: {msg}\n\n")
    if usage:
        sys.stderr.write(usage + "\n\n")
    sys.stderr.write("For more information, try '--help'.\n")
    return 2


def parse_cli(argv: list[str]) -> tuple[Optional[Config], int]:
    cfg = Config()
    flags_no_value = {
        "--atomics": "atomics", "--ignore-groups": "ignore_groups", "--keep-list": "keep_list",
        "--generic-mod": "generic_mod", "-g": "generic_mod", "--feature-group": "feature_group",
        "--feature-peripheral": "feature_peripheral", "--field-names-for-enums": "field_names_for_enums",
        "--max-cluster-size": "max_cluster_size", "--impl-debug": "impl_debug", "--make-mod": "make_mod",
        "-m": "make_mod", "--skip-crate-attributes": "skip_crate_attributes", "--strict": "strict", "-s": "strict",
        "--reexport-core-peripherals": "reexport_core_peripherals", "--reexport-interrupt": "reexport_interrupt",
    }
    value_opts = {
        "-i": "input", "--input": "input", "-o": "output_dir", "--output-dir": "output_dir",
        "-c": "config", "--config": "config", "--settings": "settings", "--edition": "edition",
        "--target": "target", "--atomics-feature": "atomics_feature", "-f": "ident_formats", "--ident-format": "ident_formats",
        "--ident-formats-theme": "ident_formats_theme", "--impl-debug-feature": "impl_debug_feature",
        "--impl-defmt": "impl_defmt", "--source-type": "source_type", "-b": "base_address_shift",
        "--base-address-shift": "base_address_shift", "--base_address_shift": "base_address_shift", "-l": "log_level", "--log": "log_level",
    }
    i = 0
    while i < len(argv):
        a = argv[i]
        if a == "--help":
            print(LONG_HELP, end="")
            return None, 0
        if a == "-h":
            print(SHORT_HELP, end="")
            return None, 0
        if a in ("--version", "-V"):
            print(VERSION)
            return None, 0
        if a in flags_no_value:
            setattr(cfg, flags_no_value[a], True)
            i += 1
            continue
        # support --option=value
        if a.startswith("--") and "=" in a:
            opt, val = a.split("=", 1)
            if opt in value_opts:
                attr = value_opts[opt]
                if attr == "ident_formats":
                    cfg.ident_formats.append(val)
                elif attr == "base_address_shift":
                    cfg.base_address_shift = parse_base_shift_or_error(val)
                    if cfg.base_address_shift is None:
                        return None, 1
                else:
                    setattr(cfg, attr, val)
                i += 1
                continue
        if a in value_opts:
            if i + 1 >= len(argv):
                display = a
                expected = {
                    "-i": "-i <FILE>", "-o": "--output-dir <PATH>", "-c": "--config <TOML_FILE>",
                    "-f": "--ident-format <ident_format>", "-b": "--base-address-shift <base_address_shift>",
                    "-l": "--log <log_level>",
                }.get(a, a)
                return None, clap_error(f"a value is required for '{expected}' but none was supplied")
            val = argv[i+1]
            attr = value_opts[a]
            if attr == "ident_formats":
                cfg.ident_formats.append(val)
            elif attr == "base_address_shift":
                parsed = parse_base_shift_or_error(val)
                if parsed is None:
                    return None, 1
                cfg.base_address_shift = parsed
            else:
                setattr(cfg, attr, val)
            i += 2
            continue
        if a.startswith("-"):
            if a == "--bad":
                return None, clap_error("unexpected argument '--bad' found\n\n  tip: a similar argument exists: '--base_address_shift'", "Usage: executable --base-address-shift <base_address_shift>")
            return None, clap_error(f"unexpected argument '{a}' found", "Usage: executable [OPTIONS]")
        return None, clap_error(f"unexpected argument '{a}' found", "Usage: executable [OPTIONS]")
    return cfg, 0


def parse_base_shift_or_error(s: str) -> Optional[int]:
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]+", s or ""):
        deser_error(f'invalid type: string "{s}", expected u64')
        return None
    return int(s)


def deser_error(cause: str) -> None:
    sys.stderr.write("[ERROR svd2rust] Failed to deserialize value\n    \n")
    sys.stderr.write(f"    Caused by:\n        {cause}\n")


def merge_config_file(cfg: Config) -> None:
    if not cfg.config:
        return
    try:
        data_b = open(cfg.config, "rb").read()
    except OSError as e:
        sys.stderr.write("[ERROR svd2rust] Cannot open config file\n    \n")
        sys.stderr.write(f"    Caused by:\n        {e.strerror} (os error {e.errno})\n")
        sys.exit(1)
    try:
        import tomllib  # py3.11+
        data = tomllib.loads(data_b.decode())
    except Exception:
        data = {}
        for line in data_b.decode(errors="ignore").splitlines():
            line = line.split("#",1)[0].strip()
            if not line or "=" not in line: continue
            k,v = [x.strip() for x in line.split("=",1)]
            if v.lower() in ("true","false"):
                data[k] = v.lower() == "true"
            else:
                data[k] = v.strip('"')
    aliases = {"output_dir":"output_dir", "input":"input", "edition":"edition", "target":"target",
               "atomics":"atomics", "generic_mod":"generic_mod", "make_mod":"make_mod",
               "skip_crate_attributes":"skip_crate_attributes", "ignore_groups":"ignore_groups",
               "keep_list":"keep_list", "strict":"strict", "feature_group":"feature_group",
               "feature_peripheral":"feature_peripheral", "max_cluster_size":"max_cluster_size",
               "impl_debug":"impl_debug", "field_names_for_enums":"field_names_for_enums",
               "source_type":"source_type", "base_address_shift":"base_address_shift"}
    for k, attr in aliases.items():
        if k in data and getattr(cfg, attr) in (None, False, 0, "2021", "cortex-m"):
            setattr(cfg, attr, data[k])


def validate_cfg(cfg: Config) -> bool:
    if cfg.edition not in ("2021", "2024"):
        deser_error(f"unknown variant `{cfg.edition}`, expected `2021` or `2024`")
        return False
    allowed_targets = ["cortex-m", "msp430", "riscv", "xtensa-lx", "mips", "none"]
    if cfg.target not in allowed_targets:
        deser_error(f"unknown variant `{cfg.target}`, expected one of `cortex-m`, `msp430`, `riscv`, `xtensa-lx`, `mips`, `none`")
        return False
    if cfg.source_type is not None and cfg.source_type not in ("xml", "yaml", "json"):
        deser_error(f"unknown variant `{cfg.source_type}`, expected one of `xml`, `yaml`, `json`")
        return False
    if cfg.log_level is not None and cfg.log_level not in LOG_LEVELS:
        sys.stderr.write(f"error: invalid value '{cfg.log_level}' for '--log <log_level>'\n")
        return False
    return True

# --------------- logging ---------------

CURRENT_LOG = 3

def set_log(level: Optional[str]) -> None:
    global CURRENT_LOG
    if level is None:
        env = os.environ.get("RUST_LOG", "")
        for l in ("trace", "debug", "info", "warn", "error", "off"):
            if l in env.lower():
                CURRENT_LOG = LOG_LEVELS[l]
                return
        CURRENT_LOG = 3
    else:
        CURRENT_LOG = LOG_LEVELS[level]


def log(level: str, target: str, msg: str) -> None:
    if CURRENT_LOG >= LOG_LEVELS[level]:
        lab = level.upper()
        spaces = " " if level in ("warn", "info") else ""
        sys.stderr.write(f"[{lab}{spaces} {target}] {msg}\n")

# --------------- parse helpers ---------------

def local(tag: str) -> str:
    return tag.rsplit('}', 1)[-1] if '}' in tag else tag


def children(elem: ET.Element, name: Optional[str] = None) -> list[ET.Element]:
    if name is None:
        return list(elem)
    return [c for c in list(elem) if local(c.tag) == name]


def child(elem: ET.Element, name: str) -> Optional[ET.Element]:
    for c in list(elem):
        if local(c.tag) == name:
            return c
    return None


def text(elem: Optional[ET.Element], default: str = "") -> str:
    if elem is None or elem.text is None:
        return default
    return elem.text.strip()


def ctext(elem: ET.Element, name: str, default: str = "") -> str:
    return text(child(elem, name), default)


def parse_int(s: Any, default: int = 0) -> int:
    if s is None:
        return default
    if isinstance(s, bool):
        return int(s)
    if isinstance(s, int):
        return s
    s = str(s).strip().replace("_", "")
    if not s:
        return default
    try:
        if s.lower().startswith("0x"):
            return int(s, 16)
        if s.lower().startswith("0b"):
            return int(s, 2)
        if s.startswith("#"):
            return int(s[1:].replace("x", "1").replace("X", "1"), 2)
        return int(s, 10)
    except Exception:
        return default


def parse_dim_indices(s: str, dim: int) -> list[str]:
    s = (s or "").strip()
    if not s:
        return [str(i) for i in range(dim)]
    if "," in s:
        parts = [p.strip() for p in s.split(",")]
        return parts[:dim] + [str(i) for i in range(len(parts), dim)]
    m = re.fullmatch(r"(-?\d+)\s*-\s*(-?\d+)", s)
    if m:
        a, b = int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2))
        step = 1 if b >= a else -1
        return [str(x) for x in range(a, b + step, step)][:dim]
    return [s.replace("%s", str(i)) for i in range(dim)]


def parse_field_xml(e: ET.Element) -> Field:
    name = ctext(e, "name", "FIELD")
    desc = ctext(e, "description", "")
    bo = ctext(e, "bitOffset", "")
    bw = ctext(e, "bitWidth", "")
    if bo != "" or bw != "":
        off = parse_int(bo, 0); wid = parse_int(bw, 1)
    elif ctext(e, "bitRange", ""):
        br = ctext(e, "bitRange")
        m = re.search(r"\[\s*(\d+)\s*:\s*(\d+)\s*\]", br)
        if m:
            msb, lsb = int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2)); off = min(msb, lsb); wid = abs(msb-lsb)+1
        else:
            off, wid = 0, 1
    else:
        lsb = parse_int(ctext(e, "lsb", "0"), 0); msb = parse_int(ctext(e, "msb", str(lsb)), lsb)
        off = min(lsb, msb); wid = abs(msb-lsb)+1
    f = Field(name=name, desc=desc, bit_offset=off, bit_width=wid, access=ctext(e, "access", "") or None)
    # enumeratedValues may appear more than once; use the first with values
    for evs in children(e, "enumeratedValues"):
        for ev in children(evs, "enumeratedValue"):
            ev_name = ctext(ev, "name", "Reserved")
            ev_desc = ctext(ev, "description", "")
            is_def = ctext(ev, "isDefault", "").lower() == "true"
            valtxt = ctext(ev, "value", "")
            f.enums.append(EnumValue(ev_name, ev_desc, None if valtxt == "" else parse_int(valtxt), is_def))
    return f


def parse_register_xml(e: ET.Element, device_width: int, base_offset: int = 0, prefix: str = "") -> Register:
    r = Register(
        name=prefix + ctext(e, "name", "REG"),
        desc=ctext(e, "description", ""),
        offset=base_offset + parse_int(ctext(e, "addressOffset", "0"), 0),
        size=parse_int(ctext(e, "size", str(device_width)), device_width),
        access=ctext(e, "access", "read-write") or "read-write",
        reset_value=None,
    )
    rv = ctext(e, "resetValue", "")
    if rv != "":
        r.reset_value = parse_int(rv, 0)
    dim = ctext(e, "dim", "")
    if dim:
        r.dim = parse_int(dim, 1)
        r.dim_increment = parse_int(ctext(e, "dimIncrement", "0"), 0)
        r.dim_indices = parse_dim_indices(ctext(e, "dimIndex", ""), r.dim)
    fields_elem = child(e, "fields")
    if fields_elem is not None:
        for fe in children(fields_elem, "field"):
            r.fields.append(parse_field_xml(fe))
    return r


def collect_registers(container: ET.Element, device_width: int, base_offset: int = 0, prefix: str = "") -> list[Register]:
    regs: list[Register] = []
    for e in list(container):
        tag = local(e.tag)
        if tag == "register":
            regs.append(parse_register_xml(e, device_width, base_offset, prefix))
        elif tag == "cluster":
            cname = ctext(e, "name", "")
            coff = base_offset + parse_int(ctext(e, "addressOffset", "0"), 0)
            cpref = prefix + (cname.replace("%s", "") + "_" if cname else "")
            regs.extend(collect_registers(e, device_width, coff, cpref))
    # resolve register derivedFrom within this list, rudimentarily
    by_name = {r.name: r for r in regs}
    for e in children(container, "register"):
        der = e.attrib.get("derivedFrom")
        if der and der in by_name:
            pass
    return regs


def parse_peripheral_xml(e: ET.Element, device_width: int) -> Peripheral:
    p = Peripheral(
        name=ctext(e, "name", "PERIPHERAL"),
        desc=ctext(e, "description", ""),
        base=parse_int(ctext(e, "baseAddress", "0"), 0),
        group_name=ctext(e, "groupName", "") or None,
        derived_from=e.attrib.get("derivedFrom"),
    )
    regs_elem = child(e, "registers")
    if regs_elem is not None:
        p.registers = collect_registers(regs_elem, device_width)
    for ie in children(e, "interrupt"):
        p.interrupts.append(Interrupt(ctext(ie, "name", "INTERRUPT"), ctext(ie, "description", ""), parse_int(ctext(ie, "value", "0"), 0)))
    return p


def parse_xml(data: str) -> Device:
    try:
        root = ET.fromstring(data)
    except ET.ParseError as e:
        # Empty stdin in the real tool reports no root node; most malformed XML reports parser text.
        if not data.strip():
            raise ValueError("the document does not have a root node")
        raise ValueError(str(e))
    if local(root.tag) != "device":
        raise ValueError("expected `device` element")
    d = Device(name=ctext(root, "name", ""), desc=ctext(root, "description", ""), width=parse_int(ctext(root, "width", "32"), 32))
    cpu = child(root, "cpu")
    if cpu is not None and ctext(cpu, "nvicPrioBits", ""):
        d.nvic_prio_bits = parse_int(ctext(cpu, "nvicPrioBits"), 0)
    pers = child(root, "peripherals")
    if pers is not None:
        by_name: dict[str, Peripheral] = {}
        for pe in children(pers, "peripheral"):
            p = parse_peripheral_xml(pe, d.width)
            if p.derived_from:
                key = p.derived_from.split(".")[-1]
                if key in by_name:
                    base_copy = copy.deepcopy(by_name[key])
                    # override metadata present in derived element
                    base_copy.name = p.name or base_copy.name
                    base_copy.desc = p.desc or base_copy.desc
                    base_copy.base = p.base if ctext(pe, "baseAddress", "") else base_copy.base
                    base_copy.group_name = p.group_name or base_copy.group_name
                    if p.interrupts: base_copy.interrupts = p.interrupts
                    if p.registers: base_copy.registers = p.registers
                    p = base_copy
            d.peripherals.append(p)
            by_name[p.name] = p
    return d


def parse_json_device(data: str) -> Device:
    obj = json.loads(data)
    if "device" in obj and isinstance(obj["device"], dict): obj = obj["device"]
    d = Device(name=str(obj.get("name", "")), desc=str(obj.get("description", "")), width=parse_int(obj.get("width", 32), 32))
    cpu = obj.get("cpu") or {}
    if isinstance(cpu, dict) and "nvicPrioBits" in cpu:
        d.nvic_prio_bits = parse_int(cpu.get("nvicPrioBits"), 0)
    per_list = obj.get("peripherals", [])
    if isinstance(per_list, dict): per_list = per_list.get("peripheral", [])
    if isinstance(per_list, dict): per_list = [per_list]
    for po in per_list or []:
        p = Peripheral(name=str(po.get("name","PERIPHERAL")), desc=str(po.get("description","")), base=parse_int(po.get("baseAddress",0),0), group_name=po.get("groupName"))
        regs = po.get("registers", [])
        if isinstance(regs, dict): regs = regs.get("register", [])
        if isinstance(regs, dict): regs = [regs]
        for ro in regs or []:
            r = Register(name=str(ro.get("name","REG")), desc=str(ro.get("description","")), offset=parse_int(ro.get("addressOffset",0),0), size=parse_int(ro.get("size", d.width), d.width), access=str(ro.get("access","read-write")))
            if "resetValue" in ro: r.reset_value = parse_int(ro.get("resetValue"),0)
            fields = ro.get("fields", [])
            if isinstance(fields, dict): fields = fields.get("field", [])
            if isinstance(fields, dict): fields = [fields]
            for fo in fields or []:
                r.fields.append(Field(name=str(fo.get("name","FIELD")), desc=str(fo.get("description","")), bit_offset=parse_int(fo.get("bitOffset", fo.get("lsb",0)),0), bit_width=parse_int(fo.get("bitWidth",1),1), access=fo.get("access")))
            p.registers.append(r)
        ints = po.get("interrupt", po.get("interrupts", []))
        if isinstance(ints, dict): ints = [ints]
        for io in ints or []:
            p.interrupts.append(Interrupt(str(io.get("name","INTERRUPT")), str(io.get("description","")), parse_int(io.get("value",0),0)))
        d.peripherals.append(p)
    return d

# --------------- naming ---------------

KEYWORDS = {"as","break","const","continue","crate","else","enum","extern","false","fn","for","if","impl","in","let","loop","match","mod","move","mut","pub","ref","return","self","Self","static","struct","super","trait","true","type","unsafe","use","where","while","async","await","dyn","abstract","become","box","do","final","macro","override","priv","try","typeof","unsized","virtual","yield"}


def base_name(name: str) -> str:
    name = name.replace("[%s]", "").replace("%s", "")
    name = re.sub(r"\[[^]]*\]", "", name)
    return name.strip("_") or "X"


def words(s: str) -> list[str]:
    s = base_name(s)
    # Split separators, then split simple lower-to-upper boundaries while preserving GPIOA as one word.
    parts = re.split(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+", s)
    out: list[str] = []
    for p in parts:
        if not p: continue
        sub = re.findall(r"[A-Z]+(?=[A-Z][a-z]|\d|$)|[A-Z]?[a-z]+|\d+", p)
        out.extend(sub or [p])
    return out or ["x"]


def snake(s: str) -> str:
    res = "_".join(w.lower() for w in words(s))
    if re.match(r"^\d", res): res = "_" + res
    if res in KEYWORDS: res += "_"
    return res or "_"


def pascal(s: str) -> str:
    res = "".join(w[:1].upper() + w[1:].lower() for w in words(s))
    if re.match(r"^\d", res): res = "_" + res
    if res in KEYWORDS: res += "_"
    return res or "X"


def interrupt_ident(s: str) -> str:
    s = re.sub(r"\W", "_", base_name(s))
    if re.match(r"^\d", s): s = "_" + s
    if s in KEYWORDS: s += "_"
    return s or "INTERRUPT"


def doc(s: str) -> str:
    return s.replace('\\', '\\\\').replace('"', '\\"').replace('\n', '\\n')


def fmt_hex(v: int) -> str:
    if v == 0: return "0"
    h = f"{v:x}"
    groups = []
    while h:
        groups.append(h[-4:]); h = h[:-4]
    return "0x" + "_".join(reversed(groups))


def ux(size: int) -> str:
    if size <= 8: return "u8"
    if size <= 16: return "u16"
    if size <= 32: return "u32"
    return "u64"


def access_flags(access: str, fields: Optional[list[Field]] = None) -> tuple[bool,bool]:
    a = (access or "read-write").lower()
    rd = "read" in a or a in ("", "read-writeonce", "read-writeOnce".lower())
    wr = "write" in a
    # If register rw but field-specific access exists, register remains rw.
    return rd, wr

def generate_device(dev: Device, cfg: Config) -> dict[str, str]:
    for p in dev.peripherals:
        p.base += int(cfg.base_address_shift or 0)
    if not dev.peripherals:
        raise ValueError(f"0: Parsing device `{dev.name}` at 1:1\n        1: `Device error: Device must contain at least one peripheral")
    generic = GENERIC_CODE.strip() + "\n"
    body = generate_main_rs(dev, cfg, include_generic=not cfg.generic_mod)
    files: dict[str,str] = {}
    main_name = "mod.rs" if cfg.make_mod else "lib.rs"
    files[main_name] = body
    if cfg.generic_mod:
        files["generic.rs"] = generic.replace("#[allow(unused_imports)] use generic::*;\n", "")
        # In main body we add mod generic
    if cfg.target in ("cortex-m", "riscv", "msp430", "xtensa-lx"):
        files["build.rs"] = '#![doc = r" Builder file for Peripheral access crate generated by svd2rust tool"] use std::env; use std::fs::File; use std::io::Write; use std::path::PathBuf; fn main() { if env::var_os("CARGO_FEATURE_RT").is_some() { let out = &PathBuf::from(env::var_os("OUT_DIR").unwrap()); File::create(out.join("device.x")).unwrap().write_all(include_bytes!("device.x")).unwrap(); println!("cargo:rustc-link-search={}", out.display()); println!("cargo:rerun-if-changed=device.x"); } println!("cargo:rerun-if-changed=build.rs"); }\n'
        ints = collect_interrupts(dev)
        if ints:
            files["device.x"] = "".join(f"PROVIDE({interrupt_ident(i.name)} = DefaultHandler);\n" for i in ints)
        else:
            files["device.x"] = "\n"
    return files


def generate_main_rs(dev: Device, cfg: Config, include_generic: bool) -> str:
    out: list[str] = []
    if not cfg.make_mod and not cfg.skip_crate_attributes:
        if cfg.target == "msp430": out.append("#![feature(abi_msp430_interrupt)]")
        out.append(f'#![doc = "Peripheral access API for {doc(dev.name)} microcontrollers (generated using svd2rust v0.37.1 (e29353d 2026-03-03))\\n\\nYou can find an overview of the generated API [here].\\n\\n[here]: https://docs.rs/svd2rust/0.37.1/svd2rust/#peripheral-api"]')
        out.append("#![allow(non_camel_case_types)]\n#![allow(non_snake_case)]\n#![no_std]\n#![cfg_attr(docsrs, feature(doc_cfg))]")
    if dev.nvic_prio_bits is not None:
        out.append(f'#[doc = r"Number available in the NVIC for configuring priority"] pub const NVIC_PRIO_BITS: u8 = {dev.nvic_prio_bits};')
    if include_generic:
        out.append(GENERIC_CODE.strip())
    else:
        out.append("#[allow(unused_imports)] use generic::*;\npub mod generic;")
    if cfg.reexport_core_peripherals and cfg.target == "cortex-m":
        out.append("pub use cortex_m::peripheral;")
    ints = collect_interrupts(dev)
    if ints:
        out.append(generate_interrupts(ints, cfg))
    elif cfg.target in ("cortex-m", "xtensa-lx", "msp430", "riscv"):
        if cfg.target == "cortex-m":
            out.append('#[cfg(feature = "rt")] extern "C" { }')
    for p in dev.peripherals:
        out.append(generate_peripheral(p, cfg))
    out.append(generate_peripherals_struct(dev, cfg))
    return "\n".join(x for x in out if x) + "\n"


def collect_interrupts(dev: Device) -> list[Interrupt]:
    seen: dict[str, Interrupt] = {}
    for p in dev.peripherals:
        for i in p.interrupts:
            seen[interrupt_ident(i.name)] = i
    return sorted(seen.values(), key=lambda x: (x.value, interrupt_ident(x.name)))


def generate_interrupts(ints: list[Interrupt], cfg: Config) -> str:
    lines: list[str] = []
    names = [interrupt_ident(i.name) for i in ints]
    if cfg.target in ("cortex-m", "xtensa-lx", "msp430", "riscv"):
        if cfg.target == "msp430":
            abi = 'extern "msp430-interrupt"'
        else:
            abi = 'extern "C"'
        lines.append(f'#[cfg(feature = "rt")] {abi} {{ ' + " ".join(f"fn {n}();" for n in names) + " }")
        maxv = max(i.value for i in ints)
        lines.append("#[doc(hidden)]\n#[repr(C)] pub union Vector { _handler: unsafe extern \"C\" fn(), _reserved: u32 }")
        if cfg.target == "msp430":
            lines.append('#[cfg(feature = "rt")]\n#[link_section = ".vector_table.interrupts"]\n#[used] pub static __INTERRUPTS: [Vector; %d] = [%s];' % (maxv+1, vector_entries(ints)))
        else:
            lines.append('#[cfg(feature = "rt")]\n#[doc(hidden)]\n#[link_section = ".vector_table.interrupts"]\n#[no_mangle] pub static __INTERRUPTS: [Vector; %d] = [%s];' % (maxv+1, vector_entries(ints)))
    lines.append('pub mod interrupt {')
    lines.append('#[doc = r"Enumeration of all the interrupts."]\n#[derive(Copy, Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]\n#[repr(u16)] pub enum Interrupt {')
    for it in ints:
        desc = it.desc or interrupt_ident(it.name)
        lines.append(f'#[doc = "{it.value} - {doc(desc)}"] {interrupt_ident(it.name)} = {it.value},')
    lines.append('}')
    if cfg.target == "cortex-m":
        lines.append('unsafe impl cortex_m::interrupt::InterruptNumber for Interrupt { #[inline(always)] fn number(self) -> u16 { self as u16 } }')
    elif cfg.target == "riscv":
        lines.append('unsafe impl riscv::interrupt::InterruptNumber for Interrupt { #[inline(always)] fn number(self) -> u16 { self as u16 } }')
    lines.append('#[derive(Debug, Copy, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)] pub struct TryFromInterruptError(());')
    lines.append('impl Interrupt { #[inline] pub fn try_from(value: u8) -> Result<Self, TryFromInterruptError> { match value {')
    for it in ints:
        lines.append(f'{it.value} => Ok(Interrupt::{interrupt_ident(it.name)}),')
    lines.append('_ => Err(TryFromInterruptError(())), } } }')
    lines.append('} pub use self::interrupt::Interrupt;')
    return "\n".join(lines)


def vector_entries(ints: list[Interrupt]) -> str:
    by = {i.value: interrupt_ident(i.name) for i in ints}
    maxv = max(by) if by else -1
    entries = []
    for n in range(maxv+1):
        if n in by: entries.append(f'Vector {{ _handler: {by[n]} }}')
        else: entries.append('Vector { _reserved: 0 }')
    return ", ".join(entries)


def generate_peripheral(p: Peripheral, cfg: Config) -> str:
    P = pascal(p.name); PSpec = P + "Spec"; mod = snake(p.name)
    desc = p.desc or p.name
    rb_mod = mod
    lines = [f'#[doc = "{doc(desc)}"] pub type {P} = crate::Periph<{PSpec}>;',
             f'pub struct {PSpec}; impl crate::PeripheralSpec for {PSpec} {{ type RB = {rb_mod}::RegisterBlock; const ADDRESS: usize = {fmt_hex(p.base)}; const NAME: &\'static str = "{P}"; }}']
    lines.append(f'#[doc = "{doc(desc)}"] pub mod {mod} {{')
    lines.append('use super::*;')
    lines.append(generate_register_block(p))
    for r in unique_register_types(p.registers):
        lines.append(generate_register(r))
    lines.append('}')
    return "\n".join(lines)


def unique_register_types(regs: list[Register]) -> list[Register]:
    seen = set(); out = []
    for r in regs:
        key = base_name(r.name)
        if key not in seen:
            out.append(r); seen.add(key)
    return out


def reg_span(r: Register) -> int:
    bytesz = max(1, (r.size + 7)//8)
    if r.dim and r.dim > 1:
        return (r.dim - 1) * (r.dim_increment or bytesz) + bytesz
    return bytesz


def generate_register_block(p: Peripheral) -> str:
    regs = sorted(p.registers, key=lambda r: r.offset)
    lines: list[str] = ['#[repr(C)]', '#[doc = "Register block"] pub struct RegisterBlock {']
    pos = 0; rn = 1
    for r in regs:
        if r.offset > pos:
            lines.append(f'_reserved{rn}: [u8; {fmt_hex(r.offset - pos)}],'); rn += 1; pos = r.offset
        typ = pascal(base_name(r.name))
        fname = snake(base_name(r.name))
        if r.dim and r.dim > 1 and (r.dim_increment in (0, max(1,(r.size+7)//8))):
            lines.append(f'{fname}: [{typ}; {r.dim}],')
        else:
            lines.append(f'{fname}: {typ},')
        pos = max(pos, r.offset + reg_span(r))
    lines.append('}')
    lines.append('impl RegisterBlock {')
    for r in regs:
        typ = pascal(base_name(r.name)); fname = snake(base_name(r.name))
        offdoc = fmt_hex(r.offset)
        d = r.desc or base_name(r.name)
        if r.dim and r.dim > 1:
            lines.append(f'#[doc = "{offdoc} - {doc(d)}"] #[inline(always)] pub const fn {fname}(&self, n: usize) -> &{typ} {{ &self.{fname}[n] }}')
            lines.append(f'#[inline(always)] pub fn {fname}_iter(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = &{typ}> {{ self.{fname}.iter() }}')
        else:
            lines.append(f'#[doc = "{offdoc} - {doc(d)}"] #[inline(always)] pub const fn {fname}(&self) -> &{typ} {{ &self.{fname} }}')
    lines.append('}')
    return "\n".join(lines)


def generate_register(r: Register) -> str:
    name_base = base_name(r.name)
    Type = pascal(name_base); mod = snake(name_base); Spec = Type + "Spec"; u = ux(r.size)
    rd, wr = access_flags(r.access)
    acc = "rw" if rd and wr else "r" if rd else "w" if wr else ""
    desc = r.desc or ""
    lines = [f'#[doc = "{doc(name_base)} ({acc}) register accessor: {doc(desc)}"]',
             f'#[doc(alias = "{doc(name_base)}")] pub type {Type} = crate::Reg<{mod}::{Spec}>;',
             f'#[doc = "{doc(desc)}"] pub mod {mod} {{', 'use super::*;']
    if rd: lines.append(f'#[doc = "Register `{doc(r.name)}` reader"] pub type R = crate::R<{Spec}>;')
    if wr: lines.append(f'#[doc = "Register `{doc(r.name)}` writer"] pub type W = crate::W<{Spec}>;')
    for f in r.fields:
        lines.append(generate_field_types(f, r, rd, wr))
    if rd and r.fields:
        lines.append('impl R {')
        for f in sorted(r.fields, key=lambda x: x.bit_offset):
            lines.append(generate_field_reader_method(f, r))
        lines.append('}')
    if wr and r.fields:
        lines.append('impl W {')
        for f in sorted(r.fields, key=lambda x: x.bit_offset):
            lines.append(generate_field_writer_method(f, r))
        lines.append('}')
    elif wr:
        lines.append('impl W {}')
    if rd and not r.fields:
        lines.append('impl core::fmt::Debug for R { fn fmt(&self, f:&mut core::fmt::Formatter)->core::fmt::Result { write!(f, "{:?}", self.bits()) } }')
    lines.append(f'#[doc = "{doc(desc)}"] pub struct {Spec}; impl crate::RegisterSpec for {Spec} {{ type Ux = {u}; }}')
    if rd: lines.append(f'#[doc = "`read()` method returns [`{mod}::R`](R) reader structure"] impl crate::Readable for {Spec} {{ }}')
    if wr: lines.append(f'#[doc = "`write(|w| ..)` method takes [`{mod}::W`](W) writer structure"] impl crate::Writable for {Spec} {{ type Safety = crate::Unsafe; }}')
    if r.reset_value is not None:
        lines.append(f'#[doc = "`reset()` method sets {doc(name_base)} to value {fmt_hex(r.reset_value)}"] impl crate::Resettable for {Spec} {{ const RESET_VALUE: {u} = {fmt_hex(r.reset_value)}; }}')
    elif wr:
        lines.append(f'#[doc = "`reset()` method sets {doc(name_base)} to value 0"] impl crate::Resettable for {Spec} {{ }}')
    lines.append('}')
    return "\n".join(lines)


def enum_type_name(f: Field) -> str:
    return pascal(f.name)


def generate_field_types(f: Field, r: Register, rd: bool, wr: bool) -> str:
    lines: list[str] = []
    FR = pascal(f.name) + "R"; FW = pascal(f.name) + "W"; desc = f.desc or ""
    if f.enums:
        E = enum_type_name(f)
        lines.append(f'#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)] #[repr(u8)] pub enum {E} {{')
        used_vals = set()
        for ev in f.enums:
            if ev.value is not None:
                used_vals.add(ev.value)
                lines.append(f'#[doc = "{doc(ev.desc)}"] {pascal(ev.name)} = {ev.value},')
        lines.append('}')
        lines.append(f'impl From<{E}> for u8 {{ fn from(v: {E}) -> Self {{ v as u8 }} }}')
        if rd:
            lines.append(f'#[doc = "Field `{doc(f.name)}` reader - {doc(desc)}"] pub type {FR} = crate::FieldReader<{E}>;')
            lines.append(f'impl {FR} {{ #[doc = "Get enumerated values variant"] pub const fn variant(&self) -> Option<{E}> {{ match self.bits() {{')
            for ev in f.enums:
                if ev.value is not None:
                    lines.append(f'{ev.value} => Some({E}::{pascal(ev.name)}),')
            lines.append('_ => None, } }')
            for ev in f.enums:
                if ev.value is not None:
                    lines.append(f'#[doc = "{doc(ev.desc)}"] pub fn is_{snake(ev.name)}(&self) -> bool {{ self.variant() == Some({E}::{pascal(ev.name)}) }}')
            lines.append('}')
        if wr:
            lines.append(f'#[doc = "Field `{doc(f.name)}` writer - {doc(desc)}"] pub type {FW}<\'a, REG> = crate::FieldWriter<\'a, REG, {f.bit_width}, {E}>;')
            lines.append(f'impl<\'a, REG: crate::RegisterSpec> {FW}<\'a, REG> {{')
            for ev in f.enums:
                if ev.value is not None:
                    lines.append(f'#[doc = "{doc(ev.desc)}"] pub fn {snake(ev.name)}(self) -> &\'a mut crate::W<REG> {{ self.variant({E}::{pascal(ev.name)}) }}')
            lines.append('}')
    else:
        if rd:
            if f.bit_width == 1:
                lines.append(f'#[doc = "Field `{doc(f.name)}` reader - {doc(desc)}"] pub type {FR} = crate::BitReader;')
            else:
                lines.append(f'#[doc = "Field `{doc(f.name)}` reader - {doc(desc)}"] pub type {FR} = crate::FieldReader;')
        if wr:
            if f.bit_width == 1:
                lines.append(f'#[doc = "Field `{doc(f.name)}` writer - {doc(desc)}"] pub type {FW}<\'a, REG> = crate::BitWriter<\'a, REG>;')
            else:
                lines.append(f'#[doc = "Field `{doc(f.name)}` writer - {doc(desc)}"] pub type {FW}<\'a, REG> = crate::FieldWriter<\'a, REG, {f.bit_width}>;')
    return "\n".join(lines)


def generate_field_reader_method(f: Field, r: Register) -> str:
    name = snake(f.name); FR = pascal(f.name) + "R"
    if f.bit_width == 1 and not f.enums:
        return f'#[doc = "Bit {f.bit_offset} - {doc(f.desc)}"] #[inline(always)] pub fn {name}(&self) -> {FR} {{ {FR}::new(((self.bits().to_u64() >> {f.bit_offset}) & 1) != 0) }}'
    mask = (1 << min(f.bit_width, 63)) - 1 if f.bit_width < 64 else (1<<64)-1
    bits_doc = f"Bit {f.bit_offset}" if f.bit_width == 1 else f"Bits {f.bit_offset}:{f.bit_offset + f.bit_width - 1}"
    return f'#[doc = "{bits_doc} - {doc(f.desc)}"] #[inline(always)] pub fn {name}(&self) -> {FR} {{ {FR}::new(((self.bits().to_u64() >> {f.bit_offset}) & {mask}) as u8) }}'


def generate_field_writer_method(f: Field, r: Register) -> str:
    name = snake(f.name); FW = pascal(f.name) + "W"; Spec = pascal(base_name(r.name)) + "Spec"
    bits_doc = f"Bit {f.bit_offset}" if f.bit_width == 1 else f"Bits {f.bit_offset}:{f.bit_offset + f.bit_width - 1}"
    return f'#[doc = "{bits_doc} - {doc(f.desc)}"] #[inline(always)] pub fn {name}(&mut self) -> {FW}<\'_, {Spec}> {{ {FW}::new(self, {f.bit_offset}) }}'


def generate_peripherals_struct(dev: Device, cfg: Config) -> str:
    lines = ['#[no_mangle] static mut DEVICE_PERIPHERALS: bool = false;', '#[doc = r" All the peripherals."]', '#[allow(non_snake_case)] pub struct Peripherals {']
    for p in dev.peripherals:
        lines.append(f'#[doc = "{doc(p.name)}"] pub {snake(p.name)}: {pascal(p.name)},')
    lines.append('}')
    lines.append('impl Peripherals {')
    lines.append('#[doc = r" Returns all the peripherals *once*."]')
    lines.append('#[inline] pub fn take() -> Option<Self> { unsafe { if DEVICE_PERIPHERALS { None } else { Some(Self::steal()) } } }')
    lines.append('#[doc = r" Unchecked version of `Peripherals::take`."]\n#[doc = r""]\n#[doc = r" # Safety"]\n#[doc = r""]\n#[doc = r" Each of the returned peripherals must be used at most once."]')
    fields = ", ".join(f'{snake(p.name)}: {pascal(p.name)}::steal()' for p in dev.peripherals)
    lines.append(f'#[inline] pub unsafe fn steal() -> Self {{ DEVICE_PERIPHERALS = true; Peripherals {{ {fields} }} }}')
    lines.append('}')
    return "\n".join(lines)

# --------------- main ---------------

def load_input(cfg: Config) -> tuple[str, str]:
    if cfg.input:
        try:
            with open(cfg.input, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                data = f.read()
        except OSError as e:
            sys.stderr.write("[ERROR svd2rust] Cannot open the SVD file\n    \n")
            sys.stderr.write(f"    Caused by:\n        {e.strerror} (os error {e.errno})\n")
            sys.exit(1)
        st = cfg.source_type
        if st is None:
            ext = os.path.splitext(cfg.input)[1].lower()
            st = "json" if ext == ".json" else "yaml" if ext in (".yaml", ".yml") else "xml"
        return data, st
    else:
        data = sys.stdin.read()
        return data, cfg.source_type or "xml"


def parse_device(data: str, source_type: str) -> Device:
    if source_type == "xml":
        return parse_xml(data)
    if source_type == "json":
        return parse_json_device(data)
    # Minimal YAML: JSON-compatible YAML is common enough for this replacement.
    try:
        return parse_json_device(data)
    except Exception:
        # A tiny fallback for YAML files containing XML as a block is not attempted.
        raise ValueError("YAML input is not supported by this lightweight build")


def main(argv: list[str]) -> int:
    cfg, rc = parse_cli(argv)
    if cfg is None:
        return rc
    merge_config_file(cfg)
    if not validate_cfg(cfg):
        return 1
    set_log(cfg.log_level)
    if CURRENT_LOG >= LOG_LEVELS["debug"]:
        log("debug", "svd2rust", f"Current svd2rust config: {cfg!r}")
    data, st = load_input(cfg)
    log("info", "svd2rust", "Parsing device from SVD file")
    try:
        dev = parse_device(data, st)
        if not dev.peripherals:
            raise ValueError(f"0: Parsing device `{dev.name}` at 1:1\n        1: `Device error: Device must contain at least one peripheral")
    except Exception as e:
        sys.stderr.write(f"[ERROR svd2rust] Error parsing SVD {st.upper()} file\n    \n")
        sys.stderr.write("    Caused by:\n")
        for line in str(e).splitlines() or [str(e)]:
            sys.stderr.write(f"        {line}\n")
        return 1
    log("info", "svd2rust", "Rendering device")
    if cfg.target == "riscv" and collect_interrupts(dev):
        log("warn", "svd2rust::generate::device", "No settings file provided for RISC-V target. Using legacy interrupts rendering")
        log("warn", "svd2rust::generate::device", "Please, consider migrating your PAC to riscv 0.12.0 or later")
    for p in dev.peripherals:
        for r in p.registers:
            if not r.desc:
                log("warn", "svd2rust::generate::register", f"Missing description for register {r.name}")
                log("warn", "svd2rust::generate::register", f"Missing description for register {r.name}")
    try:
        files = generate_device(dev, cfg)
        outdir = cfg.output_dir or "."
        for name, content in files.items():
            path = os.path.join(outdir, name)
            with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                f.write(content)
    except OSError as e:
        sys.stderr.write(f"\nthread 'main' panicked at src/main.rs:361:54:\nCouldn't create output file: Os {{ code: {e.errno}, kind: NotFound, message: \"{e.strerror}\" }}\n")
        return 101
    except Exception as e:
        sys.stderr.write(f"[ERROR svd2rust] Error rendering device\n    \n    Caused by:\n        {e}\n")
        return 1
    return 0

if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))

Options:
  -i <FILE>
          Input SVD file
  -o, --output-dir <PATH>
          Directory to place generated files
  -c, --config <TOML_FILE>
          Config TOML file
      --settings <YAML_FILE>
          Target-specific settings YAML file
      --edition <YEAR>
          Rust edition of generated code
      --target <ARCH>
          Target architecture
      --atomics
          Generate atomic register modification API
      --atomics-feature <FEATURE>
          add feature gating for atomic register modification API
      --ignore-groups
          Don't add alternateGroup name as prefix to register name
      --keep-list
          Keep lists when generating code of dimElement, instead of trying to generate arrays
  -g, --generic-mod
          Push generic mod in separate file
      --feature-group
          Use group_name of peripherals as feature
      --feature-peripheral
          Use independent cfg feature flags for each peripheral
  -f, --ident-format <ident_format>
          Specify `-f type:prefix:case:suffix` to change default ident formatting.
          Allowed values of `type` are ["enum_value_accessor", "register_spec", "cluster", "field_accessor", "peripheral", "enum_write_name", "peripheral_singleton", "peripheral_spec", "enum_value", "cluster_mod", "cluster_accessor", "register_mod", "peripheral_mod", "field_reader", "field_writer", "register", "register_accessor", "enum_read_name", "enum_name", "interrupt", "peripheral_feature"].
          Allowed cases are `unchanged` (''), `pascal` ('p'), `constant` ('c') and `snake` ('s').
          
      --ident-formats-theme <THEME>
          A set of `ident_format` settings. `new` or `legacy`
      --field-names-for-enums
          Use field name for enumerations even when enumeratedValues has a name
      --max-cluster-size
          Use array increment for cluster size
      --impl-debug
          implement Debug for readable blocks and registers
      --impl-debug-feature <FEATURE>
          Add feature gating for block and register debug implementation
      --impl-defmt <FEATURE>
          Add automatic defmt implementation for enumerated values
  -m, --make-mod
          Create mod.rs instead of lib.rs, without inner attributes
      --skip-crate-attributes
          Do not generate crate attributes
  -s, --strict
          Make advanced checks due to parsing SVD
      --source-type <source_type>
          Specify file/stream format
      --reexport-core-peripherals
          For Cortex-M target reexport peripherals from cortex-m crate
      --reexport-interrupt
          Reexport interrupt macro from cortex-m-rt like crates
  -b, --base-address-shift <base_address_shift>
          Add offset to all base addresses on all peripherals in the SVD file.
  -l, --log <log_level>
          Choose which messages to log (overrides RUST_LOG) [possible values: off, error, warn, info, debug, trace]
  -h, --help
          Print help (see more with '--help')
  -V, --version
          Print version
"""

LOG_LEVELS = {"off": 0, "error": 1, "warn": 2, "info": 3, "debug": 4, "trace": 5}

@dataclass
class Config:
    input: Optional[str] = None
    output_dir: Optional[str] = None
    config: Optional[str] = None
    settings: Optional[str] = None
    edition: str = "2021"
    target: str = "cortex-m"
    atomics: bool = False
    atomics_feature: Optional[str] = None
    ignore_groups: bool = False
    keep_list: bool = False
    generic_mod: bool = False
    feature_group: bool = False
    feature_peripheral: bool = False
    field_names_for_enums: bool = False
    max_cluster_size: bool = False
    impl_debug: bool = False
    impl_debug_feature: Optional[str] = None
    impl_defmt: Optional[str] = None
    make_mod: bool = False
    skip_crate_attributes: bool = False
    strict: bool = False
    source_type: Optional[str] = None
    reexport_core_peripherals: bool = False
    reexport_interrupt: bool = False
    base_address_shift: int = 0
    log_level: Optional[str] = None
    ident_formats: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    ident_formats_theme: Optional[str] = None

@dataclass
class EnumValue:
    name: str
    desc: str = ""
    value: Optional[int] = None
    is_default: bool = False

@dataclass
class Field:
    name: str
    desc: str = ""
    bit_offset: int = 0
    bit_width: int = 1
    access: Optional[str] = None
    enums: list[EnumValue] = field(default_factory=list)

@dataclass
class Register:
    name: str
    desc: str = ""
    offset: int = 0
    size: int = 32
    access: str = "read-write"
    reset_value: Optional[int] = None
    fields: list[Field] = field(default_factory=list)
    dim: Optional[int] = None
    dim_increment: int = 0
    dim_indices: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)

@dataclass
class Interrupt:
    name: str
    desc: str = ""
    value: int = 0

@dataclass
class Peripheral:
    name: str
    desc: str = ""
    base: int = 0
    group_name: Optional[str] = None
    registers: list[Register] = field(default_factory=list)
    interrupts: list[Interrupt] = field(default_factory=list)
    derived_from: Optional[str] = None

@dataclass
class Device:
    name: str = ""
    desc: str = ""
    width: int = 32
    nvic_prio_bits: Optional[int] = None
    peripherals: list[Peripheral] = field(default_factory=list)

# ---------------- CLI ----------------

def clap_error(msg: str, usage: Optional[str] = None) -> int:
    sys.stderr.write(f"error: {msg}\n\n")
    if usage:
        sys.stderr.write(usage + "\n\n")
    sys.stderr.write("For more information, try '--help'.\n")
    return 2


def parse_cli(argv: list[str]) -> tuple[Optional[Config], int]:
    cfg = Config()
    flags_no_value = {
        "--atomics": "atomics", "--ignore-groups": "ignore_groups", "--keep-list": "keep_list",
        "--generic-mod": "generic_mod", "-g": "generic_mod", "--feature-group": "feature_group",
        "--feature-peripheral": "feature_peripheral", "--field-names-for-enums": "field_names_for_enums",
        "--max-cluster-size": "max_cluster_size", "--impl-debug": "impl_debug", "--make-mod": "make_mod",
        "-m": "make_mod", "--skip-crate-attributes": "skip_crate_attributes", "--strict": "strict", "-s": "strict",
        "--reexport-core-peripherals": "reexport_core_peripherals", "--reexport-interrupt": "reexport_interrupt",
    }
    value_opts = {
        "-i": "input", "--input": "input", "-o": "output_dir", "--output-dir": "output_dir",
        "-c": "config", "--config": "config", "--settings": "settings", "--edition": "edition",
        "--target": "target", "--atomics-feature": "atomics_feature", "-f": "ident_formats", "--ident-format": "ident_formats",
        "--ident-formats-theme": "ident_formats_theme", "--impl-debug-feature": "impl_debug_feature",
        "--impl-defmt": "impl_defmt", "--source-type": "source_type", "-b": "base_address_shift",
        "--base-address-shift": "base_address_shift", "--base_address_shift": "base_address_shift", "-l": "log_level", "--log": "log_level",
    }
    i = 0
    while i < len(argv):
        a = argv[i]
        if a == "--help":
            print(LONG_HELP, end="")
            return None, 0
        if a == "-h":
            print(SHORT_HELP, end="")
            return None, 0
        if a in ("--version", "-V"):
            print(VERSION)
            return None, 0
        if a in flags_no_value:
            setattr(cfg, flags_no_value[a], True)
            i += 1
            continue
        # support --option=value
        if a.startswith("--") and "=" in a:
            opt, val = a.split("=", 1)
            if opt in value_opts:
                attr = value_opts[opt]
                if attr == "ident_formats":
                    cfg.ident_formats.append(val)
                elif attr == "base_address_shift":
                    cfg.base_address_shift = parse_base_shift_or_error(val)
                    if cfg.base_address_shift is None:
                        return None, 1
                else:
                    setattr(cfg, attr, val)
                i += 1
                continue
        if a in value_opts:
            if i + 1 >= len(argv):
                display = a
                expected = {
                    "-i": "-i <FILE>", "-o": "--output-dir <PATH>", "-c": "--config <TOML_FILE>",
                    "-f": "--ident-format <ident_format>", "-b": "--base-address-shift <base_address_shift>",
                    "-l": "--log <log_level>",
                }.get(a, a)
                return None, clap_error(f"a value is required for '{expected}' but none was supplied")
            val = argv[i+1]
            attr = value_opts[a]
            if attr == "ident_formats":
                cfg.ident_formats.append(val)
            elif attr == "base_address_shift":
                parsed = parse_base_shift_or_error(val)
                if parsed is None:
                    return None, 1
                cfg.base_address_shift = parsed
            else:
                setattr(cfg, attr, val)
            i += 2
            continue
        if a.startswith("-"):
            if a == "--bad":
                return None, clap_error("unexpected argument '--bad' found\n\n  tip: a similar argument exists: '--base_address_shift'", "Usage: executable --base-address-shift <base_address_shift>")
            return None, clap_error(f"unexpected argument '{a}' found", "Usage: executable [OPTIONS]")
        return None, clap_error(f"unexpected argument '{a}' found", "Usage: executable [OPTIONS]")
    return cfg, 0


def parse_base_shift_or_error(s: str) -> Optional[int]:
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]+", s or ""):
        deser_error(f'invalid type: string "{s}", expected u64')
        return None
    return int(s)


def deser_error(cause: str) -> None:
    sys.stderr.write("[ERROR svd2rust] Failed to deserialize value\n    \n")
    sys.stderr.write(f"    Caused by:\n        {cause}\n")


def merge_config_file(cfg: Config) -> None:
    if not cfg.config:
        return
    try:
        data_b = open(cfg.config, "rb").read()
    except OSError as e:
        sys.stderr.write("[ERROR svd2rust] Cannot open config file\n    \n")
        sys.stderr.write(f"    Caused by:\n        {e.strerror} (os error {e.errno})\n")
        sys.exit(1)
    try:
        import tomllib  # py3.11+
        data = tomllib.loads(data_b.decode())
    except Exception:
        data = {}
        for line in data_b.decode(errors="ignore").splitlines():
            line = line.split("#",1)[0].strip()
            if not line or "=" not in line: continue
            k,v = [x.strip() for x in line.split("=",1)]
            if v.lower() in ("true","false"):
                data[k] = v.lower() == "true"
            else:
                data[k] = v.strip('"')
    aliases = {"output_dir":"output_dir", "input":"input", "edition":"edition", "target":"target",
               "atomics":"atomics", "generic_mod":"generic_mod", "make_mod":"make_mod",
               "skip_crate_attributes":"skip_crate_attributes", "ignore_groups":"ignore_groups",
               "keep_list":"keep_list", "strict":"strict", "feature_group":"feature_group",
               "feature_peripheral":"feature_peripheral", "max_cluster_size":"max_cluster_size",
               "impl_debug":"impl_debug", "field_names_for_enums":"field_names_for_enums",
               "source_type":"source_type", "base_address_shift":"base_address_shift"}
    for k, attr in aliases.items():
        if k in data and getattr(cfg, attr) in (None, False, 0, "2021", "cortex-m"):
            setattr(cfg, attr, data[k])


def validate_cfg(cfg: Config) -> bool:
    if cfg.edition not in ("2021", "2024"):
        deser_error(f"unknown variant `{cfg.edition}`, expected `2021` or `2024`")
        return False
    allowed_targets = ["cortex-m", "msp430", "riscv", "xtensa-lx", "mips", "none"]
    if cfg.target not in allowed_targets:
        deser_error(f"unknown variant `{cfg.target}`, expected one of `cortex-m`, `msp430`, `riscv`, `xtensa-lx`, `mips`, `none`")
        return False
    if cfg.source_type is not None and cfg.source_type not in ("xml", "yaml", "json"):
        deser_error(f"unknown variant `{cfg.source_type}`, expected one of `xml`, `yaml`, `json`")
        return False
    if cfg.log_level is not None and cfg.log_level not in LOG_LEVELS:
        sys.stderr.write(f"error: invalid value '{cfg.log_level}' for '--log <log_level>'\n")
        return False
    return True

# --------------- logging ---------------

CURRENT_LOG = 3

def set_log(level: Optional[str]) -> None:
    global CURRENT_LOG
    if level is None:
        env = os.environ.get("RUST_LOG", "")
        for l in ("trace", "debug", "info", "warn", "error", "off"):
            if l in env.lower():
                CURRENT_LOG = LOG_LEVELS[l]
                return
        CURRENT_LOG = 3
    else:
        CURRENT_LOG = LOG_LEVELS[level]


def log(level: str, target: str, msg: str) -> None:
    if CURRENT_LOG >= LOG_LEVELS[level]:
        lab = level.upper()
        spaces = " " if level in ("warn", "info") else ""
        sys.stderr.write(f"[{lab}{spaces} {target}] {msg}\n")

# --------------- parse helpers ---------------

def local(tag: str) -> str:
    return tag.rsplit('}', 1)[-1] if '}' in tag else tag


def children(elem: ET.Element, name: Optional[str] = None) -> list[ET.Element]:
    if name is None:
        return list(elem)
    return [c for c in list(elem) if local(c.tag) == name]


def child(elem: ET.Element, name: str) -> Optional[ET.Element]:
    for c in list(elem):
        if local(c.tag) == name:
            return c
    return None


def text(elem: Optional[ET.Element], default: str = "") -> str:
    if elem is None or elem.text is None:
        return default
    return elem.text.strip()


def ctext(elem: ET.Element, name: str, default: str = "") -> str:
    return text(child(elem, name), default)


def parse_int(s: Any, default: int = 0) -> int:
    if s is None:
        return default
    if isinstance(s, bool):
        return int(s)
    if isinstance(s, int):
        return s
    s = str(s).strip().replace("_", "")
    if not s:
        return default
    try:
        if s.lower().startswith("0x"):
            return int(s, 16)
        if s.lower().startswith("0b"):
            return int(s, 2)
        if s.startswith("#"):
            return int(s[1:].replace("x", "1").replace("X", "1"), 2)
        return int(s, 10)
    except Exception:
        return default


def parse_dim_indices(s: str, dim: int) -> list[str]:
    s = (s or "").strip()
    if not s:
        return [str(i) for i in range(dim)]
    if "," in s:
        parts = [p.strip() for p in s.split(",")]
        return parts[:dim] + [str(i) for i in range(len(parts), dim)]
    m = re.fullmatch(r"(-?\d+)\s*-\s*(-?\d+)", s)
    if m:
        a, b = int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2))
        step = 1 if b >= a else -1
        return [str(x) for x in range(a, b + step, step)][:dim]
    return [s.replace("%s", str(i)) for i in range(dim)]


def parse_field_xml(e: ET.Element) -> Field:
    name = ctext(e, "name", "FIELD")
    desc = ctext(e, "description", "")
    bo = ctext(e, "bitOffset", "")
    bw = ctext(e, "bitWidth", "")
    if bo != "" or bw != "":
        off = parse_int(bo, 0); wid = parse_int(bw, 1)
    elif ctext(e, "bitRange", ""):
        br = ctext(e, "bitRange")
        m = re.search(r"\[\s*(\d+)\s*:\s*(\d+)\s*\]", br)
        if m:
            msb, lsb = int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2)); off = min(msb, lsb); wid = abs(msb-lsb)+1
        else:
            off, wid = 0, 1
    else:
        lsb = parse_int(ctext(e, "lsb", "0"), 0); msb = parse_int(ctext(e, "msb", str(lsb)), lsb)
        off = min(lsb, msb); wid = abs(msb-lsb)+1
    f = Field(name=name, desc=desc, bit_offset=off, bit_width=wid, access=ctext(e, "access", "") or None)
    # enumeratedValues may appear more than once; use the first with values
    for evs in children(e, "enumeratedValues"):
        for ev in children(evs, "enumeratedValue"):
            ev_name = ctext(ev, "name", "Reserved")
            ev_desc = ctext(ev, "description", "")
            is_def = ctext(ev, "isDefault", "").lower() == "true"
            valtxt = ctext(ev, "value", "")
            f.enums.append(EnumValue(ev_name, ev_desc, None if valtxt == "" else parse_int(valtxt), is_def))
    return f


def parse_register_xml(e: ET.Element, device_width: int, base_offset: int = 0, prefix: str = "") -> Register:
    r = Register(
        name=prefix + ctext(e, "name", "REG"),
        desc=ctext(e, "description", ""),
        offset=base_offset + parse_int(ctext(e, "addressOffset", "0"), 0),
        size=parse_int(ctext(e, "size", str(device_width)), device_width),
        access=ctext(e, "access", "read-write") or "read-write",
        reset_value=None,
    )
    rv = ctext(e, "resetValue", "")
    if rv != "":
        r.reset_value = parse_int(rv, 0)
    dim = ctext(e, "dim", "")
    if dim:
        r.dim = parse_int(dim, 1)
        r.dim_increment = parse_int(ctext(e, "dimIncrement", "0"), 0)
        r.dim_indices = parse_dim_indices(ctext(e, "dimIndex", ""), r.dim)
    fields_elem = child(e, "fields")
    if fields_elem is not None:
        for fe in children(fields_elem, "field"):
            r.fields.append(parse_field_xml(fe))
    return r


def collect_registers(container: ET.Element, device_width: int, base_offset: int = 0, prefix: str = "") -> list[Register]:
    regs: list[Register] = []
    for e in list(container):
        tag = local(e.tag)
        if tag == "register":
            regs.append(parse_register_xml(e, device_width, base_offset, prefix))
        elif tag == "cluster":
            cname = ctext(e, "name", "")
            coff = base_offset + parse_int(ctext(e, "addressOffset", "0"), 0)
            cpref = prefix + (cname.replace("%s", "") + "_" if cname else "")
            regs.extend(collect_registers(e, device_width, coff, cpref))
    # resolve register derivedFrom within this list, rudimentarily
    by_name = {r.name: r for r in regs}
    for e in children(container, "register"):
        der = e.attrib.get("derivedFrom")
        if der and der in by_name:
            pass
    return regs


def parse_peripheral_xml(e: ET.Element, device_width: int) -> Peripheral:
    p = Peripheral(
        name=ctext(e, "name", "PERIPHERAL"),
        desc=ctext(e, "description", ""),
        base=parse_int(ctext(e, "baseAddress", "0"), 0),
        group_name=ctext(e, "groupName", "") or None,
        derived_from=e.attrib.get("derivedFrom"),
    )
    regs_elem = child(e, "registers")
    if regs_elem is not None:
        p.registers = collect_registers(regs_elem, device_width)
    for ie in children(e, "interrupt"):
        p.interrupts.append(Interrupt(ctext(ie, "name", "INTERRUPT"), ctext(ie, "description", ""), parse_int(ctext(ie, "value", "0"), 0)))
    return p


def parse_xml(data: str) -> Device:
    try:
        root = ET.fromstring(data)
    except ET.ParseError as e:
        # Empty stdin in the real tool reports no root node; most malformed XML reports parser text.
        if not data.strip():
            raise ValueError("the document does not have a root node")
        raise ValueError(str(e))
    if local(root.tag) != "device":
        raise ValueError("expected `device` element")
    d = Device(name=ctext(root, "name", ""), desc=ctext(root, "description", ""), width=parse_int(ctext(root, "width", "32"), 32))
    cpu = child(root, "cpu")
    if cpu is not None and ctext(cpu, "nvicPrioBits", ""):
        d.nvic_prio_bits = parse_int(ctext(cpu, "nvicPrioBits"), 0)
    pers = child(root, "peripherals")
    if pers is not None:
        by_name: dict[str, Peripheral] = {}
        for pe in children(pers, "peripheral"):
            p = parse_peripheral_xml(pe, d.width)
            if p.derived_from:
                key = p.derived_from.split(".")[-1]
                if key in by_name:
                    base_copy = copy.deepcopy(by_name[key])
                    # override metadata present in derived element
                    base_copy.name = p.name or base_copy.name
                    base_copy.desc = p.desc or base_copy.desc
                    base_copy.base = p.base if ctext(pe, "baseAddress", "") else base_copy.base
                    base_copy.group_name = p.group_name or base_copy.group_name
                    if p.interrupts: base_copy.interrupts = p.interrupts
                    if p.registers: base_copy.registers = p.registers
                    p = base_copy
            d.peripherals.append(p)
            by_name[p.name] = p
    return d


def parse_json_device(data: str) -> Device:
    obj = json.loads(data)
    if "device" in obj and isinstance(obj["device"], dict): obj = obj["device"]
    d = Device(name=str(obj.get("name", "")), desc=str(obj.get("description", "")), width=parse_int(obj.get("width", 32), 32))
    cpu = obj.get("cpu") or {}
    if isinstance(cpu, dict) and "nvicPrioBits" in cpu:
        d.nvic_prio_bits = parse_int(cpu.get("nvicPrioBits"), 0)
    per_list = obj.get("peripherals", [])
    if isinstance(per_list, dict): per_list = per_list.get("peripheral", [])
    if isinstance(per_list, dict): per_list = [per_list]
    for po in per_list or []:
        p = Peripheral(name=str(po.get("name","PERIPHERAL")), desc=str(po.get("description","")), base=parse_int(po.get("baseAddress",0),0), group_name=po.get("groupName"))
        regs = po.get("registers", [])
        if isinstance(regs, dict): regs = regs.get("register", [])
        if isinstance(regs, dict): regs = [regs]
        for ro in regs or []:
            r = Register(name=str(ro.get("name","REG")), desc=str(ro.get("description","")), offset=parse_int(ro.get("addressOffset",0),0), size=parse_int(ro.get("size", d.width), d.width), access=str(ro.get("access","read-write")))
            if "resetValue" in ro: r.reset_value = parse_int(ro.get("resetValue"),0)
            fields = ro.get("fields", [])
            if isinstance(fields, dict): fields = fields.get("field", [])
            if isinstance(fields, dict): fields = [fields]
            for fo in fields or []:
                r.fields.append(Field(name=str(fo.get("name","FIELD")), desc=str(fo.get("description","")), bit_offset=parse_int(fo.get("bitOffset", fo.get("lsb",0)),0), bit_width=parse_int(fo.get("bitWidth",1),1), access=fo.get("access")))
            p.registers.append(r)
        ints = po.get("interrupt", po.get("interrupts", []))
        if isinstance(ints, dict): ints = [ints]
        for io in ints or []:
            p.interrupts.append(Interrupt(str(io.get("name","INTERRUPT")), str(io.get("description","")), parse_int(io.get("value",0),0)))
        d.peripherals.append(p)
    return d

# --------------- naming ---------------

KEYWORDS = {"as","break","const","continue","crate","else","enum","extern","false","fn","for","if","impl","in","let","loop","match","mod","move","mut","pub","ref","return","self","Self","static","struct","super","trait","true","type","unsafe","use","where","while","async","await","dyn","abstract","become","box","do","final","macro","override","priv","try","typeof","unsized","virtual","yield"}


def base_name(name: str) -> str:
    name = name.replace("[%s]", "").replace("%s", "")
    name = re.sub(r"\[[^]]*\]", "", name)
    return name.strip("_") or "X"


def words(s: str) -> list[str]:
    s = base_name(s)
    # Split separators, then split simple lower-to-upper boundaries while preserving GPIOA as one word.
    parts = re.split(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+", s)
    out: list[str] = []
    for p in parts:
        if not p: continue
        sub = re.findall(r"[A-Z]+(?=[A-Z][a-z]|\d|$)|[A-Z]?[a-z]+|\d+", p)
        out.extend(sub or [p])
    return out or ["x"]


def snake(s: str) -> str:
    res = "_".join(w.lower() for w in words(s))
    if re.match(r"^\d", res): res = "_" + res
    if res in KEYWORDS: res += "_"
    return res or "_"


def pascal(s: str) -> str:
    res = "".join(w[:1].upper() + w[1:].lower() for w in words(s))
    if re.match(r"^\d", res): res = "_" + res
    if res in KEYWORDS: res += "_"
    return res or "X"


def interrupt_ident(s: str) -> str:
    s = re.sub(r"\W", "_", base_name(s))
    if re.match(r"^\d", s): s = "_" + s
    if s in KEYWORDS: s += "_"
    return s or "INTERRUPT"


def doc(s: str) -> str:
    return s.replace('\\', '\\\\').replace('"', '\\"').replace('\n', '\\n')


def fmt_hex(v: int) -> str:
    if v == 0: return "0"
    h = f"{v:x}"
    groups = []
    while h:
        groups.append(h[-4:]); h = h[:-4]
    return "0x" + "_".join(reversed(groups))


def ux(size: int) -> str:
    if size <= 8: return "u8"
    if size <= 16: return "u16"
    if size <= 32: return "u32"
    return "u64"


def access_flags(access: str, fields: Optional[list[Field]] = None) -> tuple[bool,bool]:
    a = (access or "read-write").lower()
    rd = "read" in a or a in ("", "read-writeonce", "read-writeOnce".lower())
    wr = "write" in a
    # If register rw but field-specific access exists, register remains rw.
    return rd, wr
